column3: “Jesus” supplies the subject; inviting to stand condenses calling and setting.
“Large” renders ass-driven in the description of the millstone.
“And” replaces or between the two hands and two feet.
BSB omits this verse with the critical text; it appears in the Textus Receptus (“the Son of Man came to save the lost”).
“Privately” condenses between you and him alone.
“Regard” replaces let him be; or replaces and before tax collector.
The completed passive forms are condensed into will be bound and will be loosed.
“Jesus” specifies Him; the brother’s future sin is made a relative clause.
“Seventy-seven” gives one total for the expression seventy times seven.
Forgiving and releasing are in reverse order.
“Me” is supplied, and what replaces if anything.
Having the man thrown renders the active he threw.
